description: Air II continuous moulded canopy surface patches with a folded protective cap, real vent, crowned open straps and blended mounting-pad necks.

provenance.note: 10.2 mm lens clamping land, 1.5 mm front mounting bore, 1.1 mm clamp screw bore and 4.9 mm oval opening retain registry references. Other foot bore diameters remain a symmetry estimate.

All four foot transform origins remain on the assembled frame screw axes. Camera/clamp and arch construction anchors are unchanged. The original rear-arch terminal remains in the frozen construction path; the moulded root is blended into the collar without forcing an artificial crease through that skin.

Visible collar/cap/cheek surfaces form one patch network. Strip and foot/collar interfaces share boundary samples. Unmeasured taper, shallow crown, opening contour and reinforcement shapes are image-derived estimates; no older Air65 geometry is imported.

Opening order is preserved; the upper trapezoidal window ends slightly earlier to provide a continuous collar-root web. Strap thickness stays 0.65 mm, with 0.055 mm estimated mid-surface crown. Total assembled surface height includes half wall thickness.

nodes.notes: Crowned thin leg follows frozen long centerline. Both ends terminate at shared surface boundaries: foot neck and collar shoulder. This node is now an explicit mesh, not a ribbon.
Circular mounting bore and frozen screw center retained. Rounded pad transitions to a neck with exactly matching strip boundary samples; no washer/strip overlap is used.
